createHud roving-tabindex focus navigation (issue #115) reaches every visible, enabled control from the title screen using arrow keys alone
why: Spelled as the plausible slip -- "take it out of the tab order" -- rather than as a deletion, which the manifest schema refuses anyway. It takes both outbound destinations away from the gamepad and the D-pad while leaving them perfectly clickable by mouse and reachable by Tab -- so the defect is invisible to a person testing with a keyboard and a pointer, and it is exactly half of issue #117's "touch/controller accessible" criterion. The mechanism is one line in hud.ts: `focusableControls` selects `'button, [tabindex]'`, and a bare `<a href>` matches neither, native focusability notwithstanding. MEASURED: with this line removed the roving walk's control count drops from 85 to 83, which is the second case's failure.
